Which state has the most sellers?
rows.sql:
SELECT seller_state AS state, COUNT(*) AS seller_count
FROM sellers
GROUP BY seller_state
ORDER BY seller_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

rows.question: How many sellers are in Curitiba?
Which English product category has the most products?
rows.sql:
SELECT pcnt.product_category_name_english AS category_english, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count
FROM products p
JOIN product_category_name_translation pcnt ON p.product_category_name = pcnt.product_category_name
GROUP BY pcnt.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY product_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

rows.question: What was the total of item prices for orders purchased in 2017?
rows.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price)::numeric, 2) AS total_item_price_2017
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017;
